faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person who has control of any animal to allow such animal
               to ride in or upon any motor vehicle in such a manner as to permit injury or endanger
               the life of said animal such as:
(1)
Transporting any animal in an open truck or any vehicle in such a manner as to permit
               the animal to jump or be thrown from the vehicle by acceleration, sudden movement
               or accident involving the vehicle; or
(2)
Confinement or transportation of any animal in such a way that the animal is exposed
               to extremes in temperature or weather conditions.
(b)
For purposes of this section, the operator of a motor vehicle shall be deemed to have
               control of any animals riding therein.
(Code 1981, § 6-76(d); Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
